A &dnetwork&r is a serie of &bAE2 machines&r connected with each other. It can consist of &bmachines&r, &cstorage&r and &edisplays&r.
These &dnetworks&r can be big or small, but they have some "limits", &achannels&r.
What is a &achannel&r? It's how many machines you can connect to a cable.
You can disable &achannels&r, you would need OP, but once you get how they work, they will become easy. More info later.

quest.5BC01A68BD6802A7.quest_desc: Now, we need a way to store the recipes.
These are placed inside &6pattern providers&r and there are different kind:
- &dCrafting patterns&r: Needs a molecular assembler to craft them
- &6Processing patterns&r: Needs a machine from another mod, like a furnace.
- &aCutting pattern&r: Needs a molecular assembler (&mthey said its not worth it to do it another way&r)
- &7Smithing pattern&r: You guess it, molecular assembler too

quest.638AA96CA3E3787D.title: &5Fluix
quest.65C2A7ACDD2D9947.quest_desc: You should use these &dcables&r for your setups. Why? Simple, they show you how many &achannels&r you use, on the cable and if you look at them, they will also tell you.
But we haven't talked how to get &achannels&r, just that &bmachines&r uses &achannels&r.
Well, it's easy, place 8 cables and an energy acceptor, give it power and you have 8 free channels.
Now, you can only place 8 &bAE2 machines&r, if you try to place 9 machines, the network will stop.

Sooooo... how do we &cscale&r up things? &dControllers&r! They are a fundamental part of this mod, so you should make them. &eQuests&r will guide you and tell you which &bmachines&r uses &achannels&r.
&dSmart cables&r and &5fluix cables&r can only connect to 8 machines. You should check on &ddense cables&r.
Also, tip here, use different colors, at least 2 colors and fluix colors. That way they don't connect to each other.
quest.65C2A7ACDD2D9947.title: Smart cables

They have cool functionally in the GUI, so check them out, but the important are:
- &aFiltering&r: So 500 different thing doesn't go into the same thing
- &dExtraction&r: You can set them to extract only or insert only or both
